items.title: A Deep Learning-Based Framework for Bangla Vehicle License Plate Detection and Recognition
items.authors: Sagor Mohajon, G.M. Sakhawat Hossain, Md Mynoddin, Rishita Chakma, Tanjim Mahmud, Punam Kanungoi, Auntor Chakma
items.abstract: Proposes a deep-learning framework for Bangla vehicle license plate text recognition using image restoration and sequence recognition techniques. The framework achieves 96% character-level accuracy on a synthetic Bangla license plate dataset, demonstrating robust performance for local vehicle identification systems.

items.title: Generative-Enhanced Ensemble Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading under Severe Class Imbalance
items.abstract: Developed dual-head architecture combining ordinal regression with categorical classification for seven-stage diabetic retinopathy grading, utilizing Stable Diffusion 2.1 generative augmentation with ControlNet-Canny conditioning and morphological attention masks. The framework addresses severe class imbalance challenges in medical imaging through advanced generative techniques. Achieved 91.65% accuracy with 91.67% macro F1-score, validated through Grad-CAM++ explainability analysis for clinical interpretability.
items.tags: Generative AI, Medical Imaging, Explainable AI, Deep Learning, Grad-CAM++

items.title: Attentive TabNet Framework for Multiclass Intrusion Detection in IoMT
items.abstract: Developed TabNet-based framework with attention mechanisms for multiclass intrusion detection in Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) environments. The framework incorporates GAN-based synthetic data generation to address severe class imbalance in cybersecurity datasets. Achieved 97.96% multiclass accuracy across 89 million network traffic records, demonstrating robust performance for real-world IoMT security applications. The attention-based architecture provides interpretable feature importance for security analysis.
items.tags: TabNet, IoMT Security, Intrusion Detection, GANs
